title: Kids' Michael Jackson BAD Print Zip-Up Hoodie, Cotton Long Sleeve
intro:
Children's cotton zip-up hoodie with Michael Jackson BAD graphics on the front and back, long sleeves and a hood. Select a color, then a size from 100 to 160.

CHOOSING YOUR CHILD'S SIZE
Compare the measurements below with a hoodie that fits your child. Lay it flat, measure from armpit to armpit and double that width to compare with Bust. Also check length, shoulders and sleeves. Choose by garment measurements and preferred room for layering.
